text:
joanna: Heads up: APAC firewall cutover to default-deny scheduled 2025-04-10 02:00 UTC. Canary shows node-provisioner POSTs to vault-proxy are dropped; new GPU nodes fail to finish bootstrap.
alan: Which endpoint is getting blocked?
joanna: POST https://vault-proxy.apac.internal/v1/session/grant -> 403 from L7 policy during canary. Error: "access denied: iam condition mismatch". Provisioner needs kms:GenerateDataKey + kms:Decrypt to unwrap bootstrap secrets.
ops-bot: [schedule] apac-fw-default-deny -> 02:00 UTC. Noted by @joanna.
ben: Two mitigations: (A) short IP allowlist for vault-proxy for the rollout window (fast), (B) issue short-lived IAM delegation scoped to provisioner with forced audit tag (compliant).
security-bot: POLICY: any grant allowing kms:GenerateDataKey must set tag audit:keystore=true and call /audit-relay before issuance. RFC and short_change tag required.
alan: Ops can flip allowlist at 01:45 and revert at 05:00 UTC to unblock immediately. Risk: warm-pool churn may extend attempts beyond window.
joanna: Cost risk if bootstrap loops: estimate ~150 GPU-hours -> ~$3.5k/day. We should avoid repeated failures.
ben: I'll own allowlist flip and rollback cron; will post script + IPs 45m before.
alan: I'll prototype temp-grant script for infra-scripts that posts to /audit-relay then attaches policy TTL=900s. Draft snippet: `./infra-scripts/temp-grant.sh --role provisioner --policy provision-kms.json --ttl 900 --tag audit:keystore=true`
security-bot: Acceptable if audit-relay returns 2xx and incident #sec-audit is created. All runs must annotate RFC id.
joanna: Plan: 1) Immediate short allowlist (4h) to prevent wasted GPUs; 2) parallel delivery of temp-delegation + SIEM hook by EOD; 3) revert allowlist after validation. File RFC before 01:00 UTC.
ops-bot: [alert created] apac-gpu-bootstrap-failures threshold=5/10m by ben.
ben: RFC filed: https://rfc.internal/17663-apac-provision-exception. PR draft incoming.
joanna: Ping security for quick PR review. Also add alert if >5 failed boot attempts in 10m.
security-bot: Reminder: firewall changes without RFC & short_change tag will be auto-rolled.
joanna: Thanks team — will post final timeline, RFC/PR links, and allowlist script here.
